consumerLawApplicability.law: Zakon o zaštiti potrošača, Sl. glasnik RS 35/2026
consumerLawApplicability.article220: Entry into force on the eighth day after publication; general application after three months; articles 4(1) and 6 apply on entry into force.
consumerLawApplicability.dateQualification: Calendar derivation from the publication date and article 220, not a separately located official announcement spelling out 2 August. General application is unambiguously in force by 8 November 2026.
consumerLawApplicability.transition: Article 219 replaces 88/21; article 215 preserves rules for already started proceedings; article 218 covers subsequent digital supplies, with articles 85–86 restricted to contracts concluded after application starts.
consumerLawApplicability.article4Boundary: Certain digital services supplied for personal data are covered, with an exception where data processing is exclusively necessary for that service or a statutory duty. Zero fees alone do not settle applicability.
consumerLawApplicability.article28Boundary: Where the online-marketplace regime applies, ranking parameters, provider trader status, applicable consumer-law boundary and allocation of obligations require clear pre-contract information; terms alone are insufficient.
consumerLawApplicability.notEstablished: No conclusion that the planned physical-person operator may lawfully carry out this activity without registration.
